N° 11How to useAI setup service for small businesses

How to use Zeste

Owners of small businesses in Africa and the diaspora (tailors, hair salons, garages, restaurants, schools, transport, construction, shops) who want AI working for them without becoming technicians.

Open Zeste →Read the bookContact

WalkthroughMotion design, real screens

It plays by itself. Tap a dot or the arrows to move, Pause to stop.

01Get started

Five steps, five minutes.

1

Open the Zeste page and choose French or English at the top.

2

Take the office-work check: five yes or no questions, one minute, nothing is sent.

3

Read the first tasks it proposes for your business.

4

Watch the explainer film with the sound on.

5

Book the free diagnostic, or pick a price and write.

02Room by room

What is inside, and how to use it.

01The promise

The promise

A guardian for the business: messages, quotes, payment reminders and accounts handled with AI, set up and watched over by a real person.

HOW TO USE IT

  1. Read the promise
  2. Choose your language
  3. Turn on the ambiance if you like
  4. Take the check
02The office-work check

The office-work check

Five questions about your evenings, your quotes, the money customers owe. The result appears at once, with the tasks to set up first.

HOW TO USE IT

  1. Pick your trade
  2. Answer yes or no
  3. Listen to the result
  4. Book the diagnostic
03The explainer film

The explainer film

A minute and a half of paper animation that shows how it works: you speak, Claude prepares, you approve.

HOW TO USE IT

  1. Press play with sound
  2. Turn captions on
  3. Replay a step
  4. Share it with a partner
04Eight tasks

Eight tasks

What you say, what Claude prepares, and an example from a real trade, from supplier bills to customer reviews.

HOW TO USE IT

  1. Find your task
  2. Read the example
  3. Listen to it
  4. Ask for it in the setup
05Clear prices

Clear prices

A free diagnostic, a setup session, a setup with thirty days of follow-up, a team plan, in FCFA or dollars.

HOW TO USE IT

  1. Switch the currency
  2. Compare what each includes
  3. Choose
  4. Book
03Tips
  • Start with one task you do every week.
  • Approve every message before it goes out.
  • Keep your papers in one folder; it saves an hour a week.
  • The Claude plan is paid separately to Anthropic; my price covers my work.
04FAQ
Do I need a computer?

A phone or a computer with internet is enough.

Does it work with WhatsApp and mobile money?

Not directly: you copy and paste, and the setup shows you how.

Is it an accountant?

No. It prepares; you or your accountant decide.

What does the code unlock?

The full setup guide, given to clients after the setup session.
